Title: pnpm: pacquet trust-lockfile install can create dependency symlinks outside the project
Description: A crafted lockfile alias could reach several install-time filesystem joins. With `--trust-lockfile` or a frozen lockfile, traversal segments could create links outside the intended project or `node_modules` boundary. This patch validates dependency names and every virtual-store slot before creating directories, links, bins, or hoisted entries.
NotImpacted: All versions before 12.0.0-alpha.0, all versions starting from 12.0.0-alpha.5
